newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ABSA signs $200 mln loan on keen terms.
newsitem.headline: ABSA signs $200 mln loan on keen terms.

text.p: South Africa's Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd said on Tuesday it had signed a $200 million syndicated loan at 27.5 basis points above Libor, plus participation fees.
"The achievement of this margin sets a new benchmark for local borrowers, going below 30 b.p. for the first time," the bank said in a statement.

The proceeds of the loan -- arranged by Credit Suisse, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Citibank, Midland, ING Barings and NatWest Markets -- will be used for general funding purposes. The loan is scheduled to be drawn down on September 16.
